notes: A sample of the learning module, live on the home screen: Lesson 1 - How a candle is born. Not a PDF and not a video: the app draws it. A price line ticks across the screen and WRITES the candle beside it, naming open, high, low and close as they are set; then bullish versus bearish, the three parts called out, the five shapes drawing themselves in turn, and a three-question quiz that marks itself. Telugu, Hindi and English, switchable at the top - the animation is the same in every language because it is drawn, not filmed.
